claim: UDA planning material describes Kandy as serving much larger daily flows than its resident municipal population, including a stated commuter population of 600,000 per day.

metric.denominator: daily flows as defined in UDA city profile
metric.geography: Kandy city planning area / KMC profile
metric.period: planning baseline, exact reference year not explicit on current page
metric.source_definition: planning-flow indicators; not a census-defined functional urban area population

bounded_by: Heterogeneous planning indicators with unclear reference year; they demonstrate functional centrality but cannot be added together or treated as resident population.
notes: Functional scale evidence, not demographic rank.
